articles.title: Dark Energy Might Not Be Constant After All, New Supernova Study Suggests
articles.summary: By studying nearly 3,000 exploding stars, scientists found more evidence that dark energy — the force speeding up the universe's expansion — may change over time. This challenges the standard model of cosmology.

articles.title: Britain's Tallest Stone Row: Ancient Builders Hauled 25-Tonne Stones 11 Miles
articles.summary: Researchers traced the giant stones of the Devil's Arrows to Brimham Rocks, 18 kilometers away. The finding shows prehistoric builders made deliberate choices about where their stones came from.

articles.title: Tiny Cameras Reveal the Secret Ocean Lives of Red-Footed Boobies
articles.summary: Scientists traveled to a remote island in the Indian Ocean and attached GPS trackers and tiny cameras to red-footed boobies. The data reveals where the birds fly and how they link land and sea ecosystems.
